title: PlanDiff
description: The stored difference between two immutable plan versions (docs/adr/0004). A diff is the only way the UI explains a change, so every field a runner must see is required here rather than composed at render time. Produced by the engine, never by the LLM.

userId.description: Every table and every document carries user_id (AGENTS rule 7); RLS is the enforcement, this is the check.

fromVersionId.description: The version the runner was already shown. Never mutated. Renamed from `fromVersion` on 2026-11-04: it holds an id, and the column is plan_diffs.from_version_id (docs/engineering/contract-vocabulary.md item 19).

toVersionId.description: The candidate the runner is being asked to accept; plan_diffs.to_version_id.

createdAtDay.description: Training day (04:00 local boundary) the diff was generated in, not a wall-clock instant, because the planner is pure (AGENTS rule 1).

firstTouchedDay.description: Earliest day any change in this diff affects. Must be strictly later than the last completed day: a diff that touches the past is rejected at write time (AGENTS rule 4).

changes.description: Two changes per review, maximum; prefer one (AGENTS rule 5). maxItems is the hard clamp, changeCountWithinLimit is the same check asserted by the engine so a bad bundle cannot slip a third change through silently.

frozenDays.description: Days inside the freeze window that a review deliberately did not touch (knowledge/heuristics/review-triggers.yaml#freeze_window_days).

knowledgeHash.description: Which heuristics produced this diff, as the digest of the knowledge bundle named by the plan version it applies to; the same field and the same pattern as plan-version.schema.json#knowledgeHash. Required, because a diff is how a plan is explained months later and an unattributed diff cannot be explained.

x-subtractive-change-kinds-note: The subtract-only half of `kind`, declared once (docs/engineering/contract-vocabulary.md item 7). Three lists have to stay equal: this array, the `then` enum in $defs.change.allOf below, and the CHECK constraint changes_are_subtractive_or_not_safety in schemas/sql/schema.sql. Only the third is enforced today, by the database itself; nothing compares the three, so a gate kept outside schemas/ is row R4 of the application table in docs/engineering/contract-vocabulary.md. Until that row lands, the equality is a promise this file makes and no machine checks.

kind.description: The one change-kind vocabulary: the 12 dotted values stored in plan_diff_changes.change_kind, spelled exactly as that CHECK constraint spells them (docs/engineering/contract-vocabulary.md item 7). The seven kebab verbs this enum used to hold are demoted to narrative labels: the UI groups these 12 kinds for a runner, and the label keys belong to the message catalogue (AGENTS rule 8), which does not exist yet. They cannot stay wire values because change-dose describes *raising* a distance as readily as cutting one, and the subtract-only rule needs the finer grain to be checkable. session.added is here so a review that reorganises around a fixed race slot can say so; adding volume to make up missed work is absent on purpose and no kind permits it (knowledge/heuristics/missed-session-rules.yaml).

beforeSummary.description: Engine-authored plain text; the message catalogue, not the LLM.

reason.description: The mechanism in one sentence, in the runner's own terms where possible.

signalId.description: Id of the signal or feedback that justifies this change (see review.schema.json#evidence). Named `signalId`, not `trigger`: the review-level field is an object of evidence and was renamed with it, the column here is plan_diff_changes.signal_id, and `trigger` is a database object in every reader's head (docs/engineering/contract-vocabulary.md item 3).

expectedCost.description: What the runner gives up. A change with no stated cost is a build error (docs/ux/review-flow.md).

knobsUsed.description: heuristic ids that produced the numbers, so the UI can say 'this came from your plan rules, not from a model'.

isSafety.description: True when a safety rule caused this change; mirrors plan_diff_changes.is_safety (renamed from `safetyOrigin`, item 19). Safety changes may only subtract (AGENTS rule 3), and that is checked in two places, not asserted here: the `allOf` below refuses a kind outside `x-subtractive-change-kinds` at the API boundary, and the column CHECK `changes_are_subtractive_or_not_safety` in schemas/sql/schema.sql refuses the same rows at insert even if the engine is bypassed.
